## Featured systems

- Serbisyo: Home-services platform connecting customers with verified providers — public site and mobile apps in production. Role: Lead Full-Stack Engineer. Live: https://serbisyoprovider.com
- Enterprise Warehouse Inventory & POS (Shija): Enterprise point-of-sale and warehouse inventory system for daily sales and stock monitoring. Role: Lead Full-Stack Engineer.
- RescueLink: PHINMA University of Pangasinan capstone — emergency response and incident management for Dagupan City. Role: Lead Developer / Full-Stack & AI Engineer.
- My Crew Manager: School project — AI-powered project management with real-time collaboration and team workflows. Role: Project Manager / Lead Developer / AI Engineer.
